update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.8 - The spark reroll works, every career is graded, and the anniversary is covered
- New: every career gets an estimated overall rank (B+, A, S...) in its run history, the complete spark set each career kept is recorded (both sets when the reroll spends), and URA careers log whether the finale was actually won. 18 more characters close out the Global roster -- 213 presets across 70 entries, including parent-farming Legacy Farm builds with G1-dense racing agendas. - New: the career-end spark reroll finally works end to end -- the Reroll button is detected, the decision is priced from verified spark odds (a 2-star or better stat spark is kept, a weak one is redrawn unless a 3-star spark is worth protecting), TP is restored with items when short, and the spend button is matched against the real dialog. The queue's final run now also walks the full career-end flow instead of stopping at Complete Career. - New: Smart Borrow -- when the queue fills the empty friend slot, the bot scans the whole Borrow Card list (scrolling included) and borrows the best available card from a curated list of great picks (Kitasan Black first), with a safe fallback if a pick is refused. On by default. - Fixed: first-time races no longer stall the bot, the trophy popup closes immediately, a brief connection outage no longer ends the run, the daily-reset bounce to the lobby resumes the career in place, each career's log file contains exactly that one career, and a single run (queue off) launches the trainee whose preset you applied instead of whoever the game had preselected. - Fixed: a native memory leak in the stat-gain reader that made training analysis measurably slower the longer a session ran. - Ready for July 14: if the anniversary reskin breaks the home-screen detection, the bot falls back to reading the CAREER button's text and photographs anything it cannot recognize. Treat the first session after the update as supervised anyway. - Faster: switching trainees between queued careers drops from about 90 seconds to about 30 thanks to remembered roster positions.
